config.scope: Same-window alternating production v2 BLOB fsync mounts. Admit at 16 MiB instead of 64 MiB; keep the background start threshold at 16 MiB. Each mount compares 1MiB and 8MiB application writes, each at 64 and 256MiB total; preserve reads, overwrites, small-file fsync, metadata and aged GC guard. No format, durability, cache, SQL or SDK change; only the admission limit changes. All samples retained; diagnostics run separately.

exec.text: BEGIN IMMEDIATE
COMMIT
PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA synchronous=FULL; PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY
BEGIN IMMEDIATE
COMMIT
DELETE FROM block_payloads WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM block_versions WHERE payload=block_payloads.id)

DELETE FROM block_versions AS v WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM branches b WHERE b.state!='deleted' AND v.low<=b.frontier AND b.frontier<v.high) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM snapshots s WHERE v.low<=s.point AND s.point<v.high)

DELETE FROM dirent_versions AS v WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM branches b WHERE b.state!='deleted' AND v.low<=b.frontier AND b.frontier<v.high) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM snapshots s WHERE v.low<=s.point AND s.point<v.high)

DELETE FROM inode_versions AS v WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM branches b WHERE b.state!='deleted' AND v.low<=b.frontier AND b.frontier<v.high) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM snapshots s WHERE v.low<=s.point AND s.point<v.high)
DELETE FROM snapshots WHERE retained=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE state!='deleted' AND fork_base=snapshots.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pins WHERE snapshot=snapshots.id)

sql.text: SELECT branch,inode FROM orphans o WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM open_inodes f WHERE f.branch=o.branch AND f.inode=o.inode)
